title: Cheetah vs the fastest human
caption:
Animal athletes, episode 1.

Usain Bolt peaked at about 12.3 m/s in his 2009 world-record 100 m, while a cheetah can hold its top speed for only about 274 m.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; laser analysis of the 2009 Berlin 100 m (PMC). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
